meta.notes: id is the nummeraanduiding; only each object's voorkomen valid on the extract date; nummeraanduiding status Naamgeving uitgegeven only, its verblijfsobject in use (in gebruik, in gebruik niet ingemeten, verbouwing) or its ligplaats or standplaats aangewezen, so planned, unrealised, withdrawn and out-of-use addresses are dropped; hoofd- and nevenadressen both kept with their object's point; verblijfsobject punt, ligplaats and standplaats as the centroid of their polygon (they have no point); RD New EPSG:28992 to WGS84 by PROJ; huisletter and huisnummertoevoeging are part of the Dutch house number, written as PDOK does (12A-2), never units; road is the openbare ruimte naam, city the woonplaats (the nummeraanduiding's own if it has one, else its openbare ruimte's), postcode as written (1234AB)
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS

operations.EPSG:28992: Inverse of RD New + Amersfoort to WGS 84 (4) + axis order change (2D)
